SDE-1.dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — simple two-pointer, bitwise or binary-search problems

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Moderate — LeetCode-medium DSA (min path sum, first missing positive) then design and database depth
rounds: Round 1 (virtual, 1 hr): 2 DSA problems, dry-run with complexity, panel of an SDE-3
Round 2 (virtual, 1 hr): database and project round with a senior engineering manager
On-site rounds in Mumbai (travel arranged): LLD / machine coding with concurrency, system design, and a hiring-manager round
extraTopics: Database internals: isolation levels, locking, indexing, replication, scaling reads and writes
Concurrency (read-write locks, race conditions) in the LLD round
Reactive stack / Java backend depth for backend roles
SDE-2.notes: Typical loop is 5 rounds: 2 virtual + 3 on-site.
